notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): opcode_names.rs is Benilla's 825-entry opcode->debug-name string table used purely for logging/tracing; it names every 1.12 opcode including hundreds Benilla itself never sends or parses (GM/cheat/obsolete). MSUI realizes the same concern through its C# Op enum, whose member names print via ToString; there is no independent wire-visible contract.
